    Company Description

    We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


    We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

    Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

    If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

    With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

    Welcome to ProcessOut

    ProcessOut is a pioneer in the payment orchestration space. We are on a mission to help merchants build, scale and optimize their payment infrastructure. We work to bring simplicity, flexibility & performance to payments.

    Millions of transactions are routed via ProcessOut everyday for merchants all over the world. We are proud to partner with amazing merchants like Glovo, Bolt, Sainsbury’s, Dott, Rakuten and many more!

    We were acquired by Checkout.com in 2020 with the goal of growing our global reach.

    If you are looking to join a very fast-moving company with passionate, hard-working & fun teams, ProcessOut is for you! At ProcessOut, we are looking for people who are convinced they can play a central part in the Company's success! We are looking for people who are passionate, who are looking to achieve their full potential & who will actively contribute to strengthen the links between our teams. We value people that fully own their work and are passionate about building the next generation of online payments with us.

    The role

    At ProcessOut, Implementation Engineers play a central role in the success of the Company. We are looking for a highly motivated person to join our Merchant Experience team and work alongside colleagues to help customers get world-class guidance and advice during the implementation of ProcessOut.

    You will play a critical role in helping customers go-live, in maintaining their trust and ensuring a strong feedback loop within our teams to continuously improve our products suite.

    The ideal candidate must be customer-driven and tech-savvy with eagerness to learn in a fast-growing environment facing complex challenges.

    What we’re looking for

    • In-depth technical knowledge, particularly with a robust understanding of SaaS companies, web services, APIs, web applications, mobile apps, and IT infrastructure essential for effective

    • Native level French or English communication skills complemented by a strong business acumen.

    • Able to read and analyze server and application logs and debug errors.

    • Strong experience working with REST HTTP APIs.

    • Strong experience in project management, and ideally customer onboarding.

    • Ability to investigate and solve complex technical problems to offer the best solutions to our customers.

    Bonus points for

    • Experience in a similar role in a tech company.

    • Experience and knowledge working in the online payments industry.

    • Prior customer service experience working in a merchant-facing role.

    • Advanced data analytics skills, preferably with proficiency in sophisticated tools and demonstrated examples of analytical work.

    • Experience working with Javascript to design and build small application scripts.

    • Ability to read and understand application code (Golang).

    What you will be doing

    • Provide technical support to merchants during their implementation of ProcessOut.

    • Plan and manage their project of implementing the solution.

    • Answer all merchants’ integration-related questions, including but not limited to configuration, debugging, documentation, testing, and go-live support.

    • Manage incidents related to the integration (investigation, troubleshooting, escalation, resolution, reporting, time tracking and analysis of incidents).

    • Partner internally with account managers, technical support, and engineers to resolve issues during customer trials, integrations, or post-implementation support.

    • Interact with the Product/Engineering teams to pinpoint improvement ideas.

    • Advise Management on project statuses and potential issues that impact customer satisfaction and provide recommendations for appropriate actions.

    • Ability to multitask with multiple projects and integrations of key customers

    • Maintain and update our merchant-facing documentation to continuously help reduce friction during the implementation phase.

    We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However you identify. And whichever payment method you use.

    Our clients come from all over the world — and so do we. Hiring hard-working people and giving them a community to thrive in is critical to our success.

    When you join our team, we’ll empower you to unlock your potential so you can do your best work. We’d love to hear how you think you could make a difference here with us.

    Kestra runs arbitrary, user-defined code at scale. Our users write workflows that execute scripts, containers, and queries against their own production systems, through hundreds of community-built plugins, on a platform whose entire source code is public.     • Perform security code reviews and evaluate third-party dependencies, open-source integrations, and supply-chain risks.

    Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

    Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

    Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

    This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

    About the Role

    You'll be Vibe's founding security hire. Security has been part of how we build since day one and we're already SOC 2 Type 2 compliant, but nobody has owned it full-time. Ad spend and headcount have both roughly doubled every year since 2022, enterprise partnerships keep expanding, and the more visible Vibe becomes, the more scrutiny comes with it. Now it needs an owner.

    You'll define the risk model, set the roadmap, decide what we harden and what we accept, and turn policies into running procedures in code on the paths engineers and AI already use. That work happens in a cloud native ecosystem across AWS and GCP, with most of our services running on Kubernetes, everything as code and a GitOps deployment model.

    Reporting to our, Head of Infrastructure, and joining a lean six-person Infrastructure and IT team. You won't do it alone, but you'll be the main contributor, and the person every team turns to on security. Since we joined forces with Walmart, you'll also coordinate directly with their cloud security teams.

    What You'll Do

    Risk & Governance

    • Map Vibe's risk model across every major system.

    • Set the security roadmap with clear priorities.

    Security Engineering

    • Pave the road with guardrails and secure defaults enforced across the engineering tool set.

    • Ship the golden paths so the safe way is the easy one.

    • Harden security across our cloud native ecosystem (AWS and GCP) and third-party providers.

    • Own access management from onboarding to offboarding, and get it to the point where it runs without you.

    Detection & Response

    • Prioritize vulnerability findings by real exposure, assign them to the team that owns the code, and follow remediation through to closure.

    • Own security incident response from detection through resolution.

    • Turn manual processes into pipelines that run on their own.

    • Launch and run Vibe's private bug bounty program.

    Trust & Compliance

    • Own SOC 2 compliance end to end and maintain current certification.

    • Drive Vibe's future compliance initiatives and requirements.

    • Define Vibe's security posture and make it self-serve so enterprise deals clear security without routing through you.

    Security Culture

    • Set clear, practical rules for safe AI use, built into the tools themselves, covering both the AI we ship in our products and the AI our teams work with every day.

    • Run security awareness training and measure behavior changes so the whole company raises its bar.

    What You Need

    • Built a security function as a company's first security hire.

    • Write code comfortably and bring deep cloud-native security experience.

    • Managed a compliance framework at scale, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or HIPAA.

    • Managed AI security risk hands on, both in what a company ships with AI and in how its employees use it day to day.

    Nice to Haves

    • Ran a private bug bounty program.

    • Ad tech security background, including exposure to US privacy law (CCPA/CPRA, VPPA) in a data-heavy environment.

    • Navigated security through a company acquisition.

    Our Values

    At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

    You'll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

    This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you'll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that's moving fast.

    If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

    What We Offer

    The pay range for this role is €127,000-€171,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

    At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here's how we back that up:

    • Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

    • Hybrid flexibility — We're in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

    • Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

    • Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

    • Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

    • Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

    We respect your time. Here's exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

    1. Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

    2. Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, technical background, and approach to the role.

    4. Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

    5. Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

    Contexte scientifique et objectifs du stage :

    Des dispositifs d’électronique organique ultra-flexibles, conformables et implantables incorporant une intelligence artificielle promettent de révolutionner la surveillance et le traitement en temps réel de maladies chroniques [1]. De tels systèmes pourraient être basés sur des transistors organiques électrochimiques (OECTs), exploitant des conducteurs polymères mixtes ion-électron (PMIECs) comme couches actives. En effet, les PMIECs sont apparus comme une excellente plateforme matérielle pour interfacer la biologie avec l’électronique conventionnelle ; identifié comme le domaine de la « bioélectronique organique ou plastique ». L’OECT est considéré comme l’éléments clé pour réaliser une telle interface [2]. Son efficacité est évaluée suivant des figures de mérite (FoMs) telles que i) la transconductance (gm), et/ou ii) les temps de commutation (ionique vs. électronique) dans le dispositif. Au-delà des applications de transduction, à court terme, l’OECT est aussi intéressant pour créer des applications émergentes en matière de circuits neuromorphiques bioélectroniques [3].

    La réalisation de tels circuits est freinée par un manque de compréhension et d’optimisation des processus de conduction mixte dans ces matériaux polymériques ; notamment une asymétrie des temps de commutation des transistors lors des séquences de dopage (i.e « ON ») vs dédopage (i.e « OFF ») dans le canal de l’OECT. Des outils de caractérisation in-situ & operando permettant de quantifier et cartographier les paramètres de transduction électronique et électrochimique dans le canal de l’OECT se révèlent être indispensables pour comprendre les limitations actuelles en performances des PMIECs et/ou pour construire des PMIECs optimums dans de tels circuits neuromorphiques.

     

    Dans ce contexte scientifique, le.la stagiaire développera une nouvelle mesure de spectroscopie et instrumentation d’optique non linéaire, appelée microscopie par génération de second harmonique résolue en temps, afin d’enregistrer le mouvement spatio-temporel des espèces chargées, ion et électrons (ou trous), et ainsi donc cartographier les mobilités électroniques in-situ & operando le canal de l’OECT.

    La.le stagiaire fabriquera ces dispositifs OECTs en salle blanche de microélectronique, et bénéficiera d’un accompagnement technique pour leur réalisation. Il.elle enregistrera et analysera les FoMs clés grâce à l'expérimentation d’optique non linéaire développée et aux caractérisations électriques et électrochimiques afin d’établir, de manière plus globale, des règles d’ingénierie dans ces PMIECs qui serviront de socle de connaissances incontournables à l’avenir, pour mettre en œuvre et appliquer des circuits neuromorphiques à base d'OECTs, comme première brique d’une intelligence artificielle d’électronique organique.

    The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication – particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) – remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability.

    Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain.

    This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic–electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing.

    The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains.

    A major aspect of the PhD will be the development of system-level evaluation and benchmarking methodologies within a design-technology co-optimization (DTCO/SDTCO) framework. The objective is to provide quantitative and objective metrics for decision-making, including scalability analysis, computational throughput, and energy efficiency for target AI workloads. These evaluations will support both intermediate design exploration and the potential experimental validation of fabricated demonstrators within the broader program.

    In addition, the PhD will address electronic circuit design challenges associated with photonic accelerators, including interface circuits for control, programming of PCM elements, optical-to-electrical readout, and signal conversion. These aspects are critical for ensuring the practical integration of photonic computing units within heterogeneous AI hardware systems.

    The expected outcome is a set of novel architectures, models, and evaluation tools that will clarify the potential and limitations of silicon photonics for next-generation AI accelerators, and provide guidelines for scalable and energy-efficient implementations.


    Background: The candidate should hold or be about to obtain an MSc in Electronics Engineering, Photonics, or Computer Engineering. A strong background in computer architecture, integrated circuits, or photonic systems is expected. Knowledge of AI hardware accelerators, in-memory computing, or silicon photonics will be appreciated.

    Environment: The PhD will be carried out at the INL laboratory, within the CAMELIA program, as part of the LEAF project, in collaboration between leading academic and institutional partners in AI hardware and photonics.

    Starting dates: Fall 2026

    The Opportunity

    Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


    The Role

    As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

    • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

    • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

    • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

    • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.

    Ideal Researcher Profile

    An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



    1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

    Mastery of Core Concepts

    Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

    Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

    Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

    Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

    Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


    2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

    Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

    Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

    Turning Theory into Practice

    Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

    Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

    Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


    3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

    Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

    Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

    Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

    A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


    4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

    Efficient Implementations at Scale

    Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

    Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

    SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices.     Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real.     Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

    Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

    You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

    Why this role, now

    The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

    Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

    This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

    What you'll do

    This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

    Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

    • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

    • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

    • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


    Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

    • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

    • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

    • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

    Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

    • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

    • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

    • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

    What this role isn't

    We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

    • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

    • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

    What we're looking for

    • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

    • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

    • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

    • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

    • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

    • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

    • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

    Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

Je hebt heel makkelijk contact met eindgebruikers en kan hun wensen en ideeën snel in creatieve implementaties omzetten. Met je creatieve instelling maak je nieuwe technieken snel eigen en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete resultaten!

    Daarnaast:

    • Heb je een afgeronde bachelor of master opleiding in ICT, Computer Science, Informatica, Informatiekunde, of vergelijkbaar;

    • Heb je minstens 8 jaar relevante werkervaring, waarvan minstens 5 jaar ervaring op het gebied van netwerktechnologie, TCP/UDP, netwerkprotocollen, routering, switching en netwerkbeveiliging;

    • Beheers je meerdere programmeertalen zoals C, C++, C#, Java en ervaring in scripting om experimenteeromgevingen snel op te zetten of aan te passen;

    • Heb je interesse in experimenteren, wargaming en simulatie in een R&D-context;

    • Heb je ervaring met het ontwerpen en beheren van robuuste, schaalbare netwerkomgevingen;

    • Ben je bereid om je te verdiepen in (militaire) luchtvaartoperaties;

    • Werk je graag samen, durft je te experimenteren en kan je technische keuzes uitleggen aan niet-technische collega’s;

    • Kan jij je in de Nederlandse en Engelse taal zowel mondeling als schriftelijk uitstekend uitdrukken.

    Nice to have:

    • Ervaring met of interesse in simulatie- en interoperabiliteitsprotocollen (DIS/HLA/FOMs);

    • Ervaring met het opzetten van tijdelijke of experimentele infrastructuren;

    • Kennis van netwerkbeveiliging of VPN-oplossingen;

    • Ervaring met monitoring- of observabilitytools;

    • Interesse in nieuwe technologieën zoals autonome systemen, AI in simulatie of digitale twins.

    Wat bieden wij jou?

    Werken bij NLR, betekent werken in een nationale en internationale hightech omgeving. Samenwerken en betrokkenheid staan bij ons hoog in vaandel. Door jou vrijheid en eigen verantwoordelijkheid te geven, ben jij het best in staat om tot baanbrekende innovaties te komen. Wil jij jezelf vakinhoudelijk én op persoonlijk vlak ontwikkelen? Ook dat kan bij NLR als lerende organisatie, met daarnaast een opleidingsbudget, een mentor, interne coaches en goede contacten met mbo’s, hbo’s en universiteiten.

    Naast dit alles bieden wij jou:

    • De kans om bij te dragen aan complexe en maatschappelijk relevante vraagstukken;

    • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4330,- en € 7000,- (bij fulltime dienstverband), afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring;

    • 45 verlofdagen (bij fulltime dienstverband);

    • 8% vakantiegeld én een vaste eindejaarsuitkering van 8%;

    • De kosten voor reizen met het openbaar vervoer worden volledig vergoed. Reis je met eigen vervoer? Dan ontvang je een kilometervergoeding voor woon-werkverkeer;

    • Een zorgtoelage via onze collectieve zorgverzekering bij OHRA als extra ondersteuning voor jouw zorgkosten;

    • Extra betaald ouderschapsverlof;

    • Een goede pensioenregeling

    Jouw nieuwe werkomgeving

    Bij de afdeling Training & Simulatie werken op dit moment rond de 100 deskundigen op het gebied van simulatie, informatica, training, luchtvaart en psychologie. Binnen onze projecten wordt multidisciplinair samengewerkt, zowel binnen als buiten het NLR. De afdeling beschikt over allerlei onderzoeksfaciliteiten zoals een battlelab en simulatoren voor gevechtsvliegtuig- en onbemande systemen en een laboratorium dat zich richt op AR/VR innovaties. Een plezierige werkomgeving vinden we essentieel. De sfeer binnen de afdeling is informeel en collegiaal en we vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen zich thuis kan voelen bij ons.

    Wat betekent werken bij NLR?

    Koninklijke NLR is al ruim 100 jaar een kennisorganisatie met de wil en ambitie om te vernieuwen. Vanuit die drijfveer maken wij de wereld van lucht- en ruimtevaart veiliger, duurzamer, efficiënter en effectiever en staan wij voor baanbrekende innovaties.

    Bij ons werken bijna 1000 gedreven professionals, van vliegtuigbouwkundigen tot psychologen en van wiskundigen tot applicatiedeskundigen. NLR staat voor een inclusieve en diverse organisatie waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig, gewaardeerd en gerespecteerd voelt.

    Wil jij meer weten?

    Bel of mail dan met Pien Moller (recruiter) via 0611443915 of Onze collega’s vertellen jou graag hoe het is om bij NLR te werken. Vergeet trouwens ook niet eens een kijkje op onze socials te nemen zoals ons YouTube kanaal.

    Solliciteren?

    Mooi, we zijn benieuwd naar jou! Stuur je motivatiebrief en CV via de ‘Solliciteren’ button.

     

    Een positieve uitkomst van een veiligheidsonderzoek (VGB) is een voorwaarde voor indiensttreding. Meer informatie daarover lees je op de website van de MIVD.

    Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld!

LanguageLine Solutions is Hiring!

At LanguageLine, we strive for a world in which language and cultural barriers no longer exist. Use your language skills to dramatically improve the lives of limited-English speakers, as well as the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing. Even better, you can do this while working from your own home.

LanguageLine has been certified as a Great Place to Work, and is regularly listed as one of America’s top work-from-home employers.

Our interpreters serve clients across numerous industries, including health care, 911, first responders, education, government agencies, and all walks of business.

As an interpreter, you will receive training that is the best in the industry. We’ll ensure that you learn new skills while further developing your skillset. We provide numerous opportunities for advancement. You’ll be in a certified ASTM and ISO environment. You'll also be supported by a Senior Language Specialist, as well as our Interpreter and Technology Help Desks.

Join our team now!

Job Description

Work at Home Bilingual Chaldean-English Phone Interpreter


Job Title: Chaldean Interpreter

Location: Work at Home position in United States

Position: Phone Interpreter

Status: Independent Contractor

Pay: $0.70 - $0.85 per minute


We Offer:

  • Employee Referral Program.
  • Advancement opportunities within the organization.
  • Interpreter support.
  • An inclusive and diverse work environment.
  • **This is an independent contractor position and therefore not eligible for employee benefits.**

Position Overview:


The Chaldean Telephone Interpreter is responsible for handling calls on demand, and renders the meaning of conversations between Chaldeanand English speakers. The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.


**This is a remote position. The Interpreter works from his/her home-office. It is essential to ensure a quiet & secure environment.**


Essential Job Functions

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.
  • Render correct concepts and meanings according to the conventions of established interpretation protocol, avoiding omissions or additions.
  • Speak clearly in both languages using proper pronunciation, enunciation and polite expressions.
  • Maintain a professional demeanor throughout the interpreting sessions at all times.
  • Remain calm during interpreting sessions in the event that one of the primary speakers is incoherent or upset, especially in emergency situations such as 911 calls.
  • Maintain punctuality and availability during work hours.
  • Follow client instructions, in compliance with protocol to ensure client expectations are met with the Limited English-speaking Person (LEP), avoiding interaction with the LEP without client’s permission.
  • Understand protocol and terminology for various industries including, but not limited to, Medical, Insurance, Finance and Law.
  • Demonstrate commitment to cultural sensitivity and working in a diverse environment.
  • **Some calls may be highly emotional and/or stressful in nature. The interpreter may need to remain on a call for extended periods without breaks due to the nature of the call or may, at times experience high call volumes. The interpreter must have the ability to provide the required, company standards of service within this dynamic environment. **

Qualifications

  • Fluency in Chaldeanand English and skilled in the associated cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to provide cultural competency and assess regional and accent differences to find ways of communicating with the LEP.
  • Excellent listening, retention and note-taking skills to maintain a high level of accuracy during interpretation.
  • Ability to concentrate, stay detached from the conversation, remain neutral and objective at all times, and remain on calls that involve sensitive subjects such as end of life conversations, pregnancy termination, vaccinations, and matters concerning sexual orientation and/or gender expression.
  • Education or work experience in language-related fields such as teaching, language assessment, translation or interpretation preferred.
  • Must be able to adapt to any LLS technology enhancements that improve service delivery and meet client demands.
  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Applicants for employment in the US must have work authorization that does not now or in the future require sponsorship of a visa for employment authorization in the United States and with LanguageLine Solutions (i.e., H1-B visa, F-1 visa (OPT), TN visa or any other non-immigrant status).
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Candidates who are currently employed by a client of LanguageLine Solutions or an affiliated LanguageLine Solutions business may not be eligible for consideration.
  • Ability to read and write the requested languages - highly preferred.

**Based on your location, a post-offer, a pre-employment background check and/or drug screen may be required**


Technical Requirements:

  • Dedicated personal device for business purposes.
    • Desktop / Laptop Computers with any of the following Operating Systems: Windows, MacOS, or ChromeOS.
    • Tablets (iPadOS or Android) are acceptable.
    • Smartphones (iOS or Android) are also acceptable.
  • Restricted brands:
    • Kaspersky products.
    • Huawei hardware.
  • High speed Internet connection for work related electronic communication. This internet connection should provide download speeds of no less than 5 Mbps, upload speeds of 3 Mbps, Ping value of no more than 300 ms, Jitter value of no more than 30 ms.
  • Must have access to a quiet space free from background noise or distraction.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to operate a keyboard and mouse and remain in a stationary position in front of a computer the majority of the workday.
  • Must be able to operate company provided software and systems to perform all aspects of the job.
  • Must have sufficient manual dexterity to type or write.
  • Able to lift up to 26 lbs.
  • May be exposed to moderate noise levels; i.e. computer, audio, telephone.

The client moves fast. Your job is to make sure nothing falls through the cracks — before anyone notices it almost did.

About RemotePro.ph

We’re a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We’ve been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We’ve grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.

To apply, please visit us at:

Summary

This role is focused on California insurance — personal and commercial lines. A big part of your day will be handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing. If you've worked inside a California insurance agency recently and know how personal and commercial lines operate — you'll feel right at home here. If you haven't, this role isn't the right fit.

Beyond the insurance work, you'll be supporting day-to-day operations — managing communication, keeping things organized, and making sure nothing gets missed. You'll be expected to use AI tools regularly to work faster and produce better outputs. Not occasionally. Daily.

The Mindset We’re Looking For

The best Executive Support Specialists we’ve worked with share a few traits:

  • They’re the person their friends call when they need to figure something out. Not because they always have the answer — but because they know how to think through a problem, ask the right questions, and get to a solution
  • They don’t wait to be told. If they see something that needs to happen, they handle it — then let the client know it’s done, not ask if they should do it
  • They’re honest even when it costs them. If they make a mistake, they say so immediately. If something isn’t working, they raise it. They don’t manage perception — they manage reality
  • They’re genuinely curious. It’s not enough to be smart — they actively seek out new things to learn, ask questions other people don’t think to ask, and find most topics at least a little interesting
  • They treat confidentiality as non-negotiable. What happens in the client’s world stays there — no exceptions, no grey areas
  • They use AI the way a sharp operator would — not as a novelty, but as a tool that makes their output faster and better than anyone who isn’t using it

Who Thrives Here

People who are quietly excellent — not flashy, but consistently sharp, reliable, and ahead of the curve. You don’t need recognition for every task you handle. You find satisfaction in the fact that things run smoothly because of you, even if no one notices the work behind it.

We’re a growing MSP, which means priorities shift, new tasks appear, and not everything is perfectly documented yet. For the right person, that’s not a problem — it’s an environment where someone who takes initiative and uses every tool available naturally stands out.

This Role Is Not for You If:

  • You need constant direction and check-ins to stay on track
  • You treat “that’s not my job” as a reasonable response
  • You let things slip and wait for someone else to notice
  • You’d stay quiet about a mistake to avoid a difficult conversation
  • Confidentiality feels like a guideline rather than a hard rule
  • You’re uncomfortable with shifting priorities and changing plans
  • You’ve never seriously used AI tools in your daily work and don’t intend to start
  • Learning new things feels like a chore rather than something you actually enjoy

There’s no judgment in that list — it’s just not the environment. We’d rather be honest now than waste each other’s time.

Responsibilities

You'll be managing a mix of insurance operations and administrative support in a fast-moving remote environment. Your job is to keep things running, stay ahead of deadlines, and make sure nothing gets dropped.

That looks like:

  • Handling renewals, quotes, and account servicing for personal and commercial insurance lines — this is the core of the role
  • Managing inbound communication across email and phone — triaging, responding where appropriate, and escalating only what genuinely needs attention
  • Tracking open action items, follow-ups, and deadlines so nothing slips — and flagging anything at risk before it becomes a problem
  • Managing calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination
  • Preparing reports, summaries, and briefing materials that are clear and ready to use without further editing
  • Maintaining organized records across CRM systems and shared drives — so information is always findable and current
  • Using AI tools to draft communications, summarize threads, and eliminate repetitive manual tasks
  • Supporting market research, competitor analysis, and social media scheduling when needed

Requirements

About the company

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project.

Project Highlights

  • Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance
  • Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when
  • Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All contributors are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved

What this project involves

We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales.

Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself.

What we look for

This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome;
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks

Flexibility

You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria.

Earnings

Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved.
  • Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

➢ Can influence, partner and be effective in working with many internal teams to get the job done.

➢ Is nimble, agile, comfortable with change, learning new things

➢ Communicate and interact with fulfillment departments/Vendors/Clinics regarding issues related to OHS open Orders & to get results from Clinics Overall assistance in an effort to enhance and improve the rapid resolution of client issues and requests.

➢ Ensure that all requests and case management workflows are resolved in a timely manner to meet contractual SLAs and client expectations.

➢ Conduct client needs analysis presentations to management as requested

➢ Conduct and deliver additional projects as assigned by manager

➢ Handle additional responsibilities outside of standard daily support tasks.

➢ Taking ownership and driving client projects from beginning to end

➢ Assists with training of new employees.

Qualifications: - Under Graduate/ Graduate

- Must be able to analyze a situation and respond quickly in a courteous and professional manner

- Must have excellent written & verbal communication skills.

- Must understand all aspects of the fulfillment process and be able to effectively explain them to the requestor.

- Capable of handling a large number of calls and e-mails

- Self-starter and have an ability to see the process through from start to finish

At GoGlobal, the Regional Product Owner (GPO), Accounting & Tax owns the A&T product end to end — its global scope, standards, commercial logic, processes, and economics — and leads the function as a Managing Director–level member of the Delivery leadership team. Reporting to the Chief Delivery Officer, you are accountable for the growth, profitability, and reputation of A&T worldwide.

This is a leadership role whose primary objective is business growth through flawless delivery. You are the senior product and delivery voice for A&T in the market — client-facing, trusted by prospects and key accounts, and the partner of choice for Revenue and Sales in winning and expanding business. As the ultimate subject-matter expert for A&T, you stay close to market trends and customer demands and translate them into how the service is designed, packaged, priced, and delivered.

You lead the A&T function regionally through the Outsourcing Control (OC) leads. You build the delivery organisation to meet both market opportunity and client expectation, set and defend global standards as the foundation for scalable and sustainable delivery, and act as an inspiring leader for the teams who deliver A&T every day.

Roles & Responsibilities

Commercial Leadership & Growth

• Own the growth agenda for A&T — revenue, win rate, retention, and expansion — as the primary measure of the role’s success.

• Act as the senior, client-facing product authority for A&T: anchoring strategic client engagements, pitches, high-stakes decisions, and escalations.

• Partner with Revenue and Sales as the expert in the room — qualifying opportunities, shaping scope and pricing, and helping convert and expand accounts.

• Define and evolve the commercial logic — packaging, bundling, premiums, and guardrails — so A&T can be sold and delivered profitably at scale.

• Own the reputation of the A&T product in the market.

Product Strategy & Standards

• Own the regional scope, service definitions, and standards for A&T — what is in, what is out, and how it is delivered.

• Set regional execution standards, SLAs, and compliance expectations across all regions and delivery models.

• Drive consistency of delivery across regions while enabling them to flex within agreed guardrails.

Market Insight & Service Design

• Act as the ultimate subject-matter expert for A&T, maintaining a deep, current view of market trends, competitor moves, and evolving customer demands.

• Translate market and client insight into the design of the service and the delivery organisation, so the function is structured to meet both demand and expectation.

• Shape the product roadmap and delivery-model choices (in-house, outsourced, automated) to capture growth opportunities.

Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement

• Set the regional A&T operating model and process standards; approve processes, SOPs, and control frameworks before they enter delivery.

• Support the enterprise AI direction and drive its adoption within A&T to enable scale and quality.

Cost Management & Commercial Sustainability

• Own product-level cost-to-serve for A&T, driving efficiency, productivity, and long-term economic sustainability.

• Make deliberate trade-offs across scope design, automation, sourcing, and delivery-model choices to keep delivery economics healthy as the product scales.

• Diagnose cost pressures, identify root causes, and lead corrective action, supported by Finance on modelling and analysis.

Regional Delivery Governance & Team Leadership

• Lead the Outsourcing Control leads accountable for regional delivery outcomes and economics.

• Provide the framework within which regional autonomy — in-house versus outsourced mix, capacity, and hiring proposals — is exercised, and arbitrate cross-regional or peer-function disagreements when escalated.

• Lead, mentor, and develop the OC leads; build product, commercial, and delivery capability across the global A&T team.

Scope & Commercial Governance

• Propose and own changes to product scope, service tiers, and commercial logic, routing them through the agreed approval framework for impact assessment and implementation readiness.

• Support enabling functions on scope-to-catalogue mapping, SKU registration, and pricing alignment.

• Validate post-implementation effectiveness of scope and commercial changes through defined metrics, and refine where needed.

Compliance, Audit & Risk

• Set the regional compliance posture for A&T across accounting standards (IFRS, local GAAP), tax legislation, and statutory reporting requirements.

• Ensure A&T delivery maintains internal controls and regulatory adherence in every jurisdiction the product serves.

• Engage with internal and external audit on A&T product-level matters.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with the Chief Delivery Officer, peer Global Product Owners, Revenue, Technology, and the enabling functions across Delivery.

• Represent the A&T product in cross-functional and executive forums.

Key Performance Indicators

• Revenue growth and win rate for the product.

• Retention and net revenue retention (NRR).

• Margin and cost-to-serve.

• Delivery SLA attainment and quality.

• Client satisfaction (NPS).

ment of your Personal Data.

Requirements

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred. MBA or equivalent is a plus.

• 15+ years of experience in accounting, tax, or finance operations, with at least 5 years owning a product, service line, or regional / global function end to end.

• Managing Director–level leadership experience, with the gravitas to operate as a senior commercial and product leader.

• Track record of driving growth — revenue, win rate, retention, and expansion — not only delivery.

• Experience running a service-line P&L at scale — owning cost-to-serve, productivity, margin, and pricing logic.

• Strong working knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP, tax legislation, and statutory reporting requirements across multiple regions (APAC, EMEA, and ideally the Americas).

• Demonstrated experience designing service standards, commercial logic (packaging, bundling, premiums), and pricing frameworks.

• Strong client-facing and business-development capability, comfortable as the senior product voice in front of clients and prospects.

• Experience leading senior delivery and product leaders — regional heads, process leads, and outsourcing-control / vendor-management leads — across multiple regions.

• Deep market awareness, with the ability to read trends and customer demand and shape the service accordingly.

• Process-oriented mindset, believing in global standards as the foundation for scalable, sustainable delivery — with the judgement to know where flexibility serves the client.

• Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills; comfortable with financial modelling, scenario analysis, and unit economics.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence at executive level.

• Proficiency in accounting platforms — Xero in particular (the central A&T platform) — and other ERP / accounting systems (QuickBooks, SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).

• Comfort with AI-assisted tools and automation as enablers of product scale and quality.

Preferred

• Prior experience as a product or service-line head in a global outsourced accounting / corporate-services firm or in a Big-4 advisory / managed services context.

• Experience leading a P&L turnaround, transformation, or in-housing programme.

• Experience operating in an EoR, PEO, or global business services environment.

Benefits

OVERVIEW

As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames.

Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right.

We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success.

We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like:

A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact

Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team

Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth

WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT

We Make Growing Your Career Possible

    • We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way.
    • We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations
    • English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world.
    • We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success.
    • We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership.
    • We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions.
    • We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world.

Ready to take the next step in your career with us? Apply now!

**Kindly review the provided privacy notice (LINK) to gain a comprehensive understanding of our policies and practices governing the treatment of your Personal Data. By applying, you consent to background and reference checks, to the extent permissible by law.

      <title>Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Processing</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.</p>
<p>Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.</p>
<p>We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others.&nbsp;</p>
<p>We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City.&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Position:</strong> Senior Software Engineer, Processing</p>
<p><strong>Location:</strong> Remote</p>
<p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> for our Processing team to lead Lithic’s next phase of growth.</p>
<p>The Processing team builds and maintains the real-time interfaces between Lithic and external payment networks. Every card authorization, clearing message, and settlement file flows through systems this team owns. The team manages both online and batch transaction flows across Mastercard, Visa, and Amex, along with transaction enrichment, disputes processing, and network compliance. The systems we maintain have strict latency and uptime requirements, because they sit on the critical path for every card transaction. The team also manages the physical network peering with card network partners, so infrastructure and networking expertise are important. The team primarily uses Java, Python, and Kotlin on AWS.</p>
<h3><strong>What you'll do:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Ensure high reliability, low latency, and correctness for Lithic's transaction processing interfaces and related services</li>
<li>Develop new capabilities across authorization, clearing/settlement, disputes, and network integration surfaces</li>
<li>Ensure that the team is delivering reliable, secure, and scalable code with minimal tech debt</li>
<li>Evolve the infrastructure supporting physical network peering with card network partners, ensuring connectivity, failover, and capacity meet reliability requirements</li>
<li>Own initiatives from planning to launch, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned along the way</li>
<li>Participate in the team on-call rotation</li>
<li>Lead efforts to improve systems and processes both within the team and across engineering</li>
<li>Help drive strategic planning in collaboration with the engineering manager and product manager</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What you'll bring:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>8+ years experience shipping code in fast paced production environments</li>
<li>Advanced distributed system instincts and design skills</li>
<li>Experience driving large cross-functional projects across engineering, product, and operations teams</li>
<li>A proven commitment to empathy and inclusion</li>
<li>Excellent communication skills</li>
<li>Growth mindset and continuous desire to learn and improve is a must</li>
<li>An interest in fintech and the payments space is preferred</li>
</ul>
<p>The annual US salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States, Canada (Ontario or British Columbia), Netherlands, Poland, or Czech Republic. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>
<p>This is a hybrid position. Candidates must be located within a commutable distance to our NYC office in Soho. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.</p>

<p>NYC-based employees work from our SoHo office three days a week. Tuesdays and Thursdays are our core days, and you'll choose a third day that works for your schedule and team needs.</p>

      <title>Squarespace: Staff Software Engineer, Revenue Systems</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City; Remote
</p>

<p>Squarespace is seeking a talented Staff Software Engineer to support and evolve the systems at the core core of our monetization platform: billing, payments and orders. In this role, you will provide technical oversight over the critical monetization machinery that accepts orders, processes payments and bills subscriptions. You will regularly collaborate with engineering leadership and key product, strategy and finance stakeholders to align technical strategy with Squarespace’s business objectives. This is an opportunity to take on IC technical leadership responsibilities and own system architecture for high-visibility initiatives tied directly to Squarespace's core businesses.</p>
<p>This role is open to remote or hybrid working from our NYC office 3 days per week. You will report to the Director of Revenue Systems.</p>
<h2><strong>You'll Get To...</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>Own system architectural vision and design for critical areas of our business.</li>
<li>Transform high-level system vision into estimated project plans for initiatives central to Squarespace’s strategy.</li>
<li>Serve as technical lead and cross-functional liaison on business-critical projects, making and defending engineering decisions key to the success of the business.</li>
<li>Mentor engineers on the team to deliver ever greater quality with ever growing autonomy.</li>
<li>Drive best practices for engineering excellence and technical leadership, influence design reviews, question assumptions, point out pitfalls and foster shared understanding</li>
<li>Set the engineering quality bar for the team through regular, high-quality code contributions across billing, orders and payments.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Who We're Looking For</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>10 or more years experience specifying, delivering and maintaining complex distributed backend services.</li>
<li>Significant experience with multiple programming languages (especially Java) and a broad range of tools like Springboot, hibernate, databases, etc.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience leading system architecture decisions across multiple teams or initiatives</li>
<li>Proven ability to serve as a technical lead on cross-functional projects, aligning engineering and business goals without sacrificing engineering quality</li>
<li>Experience working with billing, orders or payment systems at scale</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>A choice between medical plans with an option for 100% covered premiums including medical, dental, and vision</li>
<li>Supplemental Life and Disability Insurance plans</li>
<li>Fertility and adoption benefits</li>
<li>Headspace mindfulness app subscription</li>
<li>Global Employee Assistance Program</li>
<li>Retirement benefits with employer match</li>
<li>Flexible paid time off</li>
<li>12 weeks paid parental leave and family care leave</li>
<li>Pretax commuter benefit</li>
<li>Education reimbursement</li>
<li>Employee donation match to community organizations</li>
<li>7 Global Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)</li>
<li>Dog-friendly workplace</li>
<li>Free lunch and snacks</li>
<li>Private rooftop</li>
<li>Hack week twice per year</li>
</ul>
<h3>Cash Compensation Range: $170,000 - $299,000 USD</h3>
<p>The base salary for this position will vary based on job-related criteria including relevant skills, experience, and location, among other factors.</p>
<p>In addition to the cash compensation above (which includes base salary and, where applicable for eligible roles, may include overtime pay), Squarespace employees are eligible to be granted an option to purchase our common stock. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive structure in addition to base salary.</p>
<h2><strong>About Squarespace</strong></h2>
<p>Squarespace is a design-driven platform helping entrepreneurs build brands and businesses online. We empower millions of customers in more than 200 countries and territories with all the tools they need to create an online presence, build an audience, monetize, and scale their business. Our suite of products range from websites, domains, ecommerce, and marketing tools, as well as tools for scheduling with Acuity and creating and managing social media presence with Bio Sites and Unfold. Our team of more than 1,700 is headquartered in New York City, with offices in Dublin, Ireland, and Aveiro, Portugal. For more information about our company, visit <a href="https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers">https://www.squarespace.com/about/careers</a>.</p>
<h2><strong>Our Commitment</strong></h2>
<p>Today, more than a million people around the globe use Squarespace to share different perspectives and experiences with the world. Not only do we embrace and celebrate the diversity of our customers, but we also work toward the same in our employees. At Squarespace, we are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or other class protected by applicable law. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.</p>
