      <title>Askable: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract) </title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6591/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Australia 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://www.askablelabs.com/">https://www.askablelabs.com/</a>
</p>

<p>We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.</p>
<p>You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.</p>
<p>Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.</p>
<p><strong>How it works</strong></p>
<ol class="iiilu2 iiil4m iiimkb">
<li><strong>Apply. </strong>Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.</li>
<li><strong>Propose.</strong> Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.</li>
<li><strong>Build.</strong> In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.</li>
<li><strong>Stress-test. </strong>Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.</li>
<li><strong>Model testing.</strong> Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.</li>
<li><strong>Review.</strong> A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.</li>
<li><strong>Next task.</strong> Once your task is accepted, start another.</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>2+ years of professional software engineering</li>
<li>Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)</li>
<li>Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++</li>
<li>Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing</li>
<li>Regular use of an AI coding tool</li>
<li>Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models</li>
<li>You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words</li>
<li>At least 10 hours a week, starting now</li>
<li>A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure</li>
<li>Experience building agent tasks or RL environments</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Terms</strong></p>
<ul class="iiilu2 iiil4n iiimkb">
<li>US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you</li>
<li>Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms</li>
<li>The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us</li>
<li>Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork</li>
</ul>
<p>Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/askable-software-engineer-ai-coding-tasks-contract</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Medify: Engineering Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6586/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> London
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://www.medify.co.uk">http://www.medify.co.uk</a>
</p>

<p>Remote | Full-Time | UK&nbsp;<br><br></p>
<p>About Us</p>
<p>At Medify, we’re on a mission to widen access to medicine and healthcare careers through world-class digital learning experiences. Since 2009, we’ve helped thousands of students prepare for high-stakes admissions tests, and we’re continuing to invest in our technology to build innovative, scalable products that support learners around the world.</p>
<p>As we continue to grow, we’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead, mentor and develop our engineering team while remaining hands-on in building the platform that powers Medify.<br><br></p>
<p>The Role</p>
<p>As an Engineering Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in shaping both our engineering culture and technical direction. Working closely with the CTO, Product and Design teams, you’ll lead a team of talented full-stack engineers, helping them grow while ensuring we continue to deliver high-quality software that delights our users.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on leadership role, with at least 50% of your time dedicated to engineering. You’ll contribute across the full software development lifecycle - from architecture and design through to development, testing and deployment - while driving engineering excellence and fostering a collaborative, high-performing team.</p>
<p>Our current technology stack includes Ruby on Rails, React, PostgreSQL, with infrastructure transitioning from Heroku to AWS.<br><br></p>
<p>Key Responsibilities</p>
<ul>
<li>Lead, mentor and support a team of full-stack engineers through coaching, regular 1:1s and performance reviews.</li>
<li>Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration and technical excellence.</li>
<li>Support career development, engagement and long-term capability building across the engineering team.</li>
<li>Contribute to hiring by supporting interviews and recruitment of exceptional engineering talent.</li>
<li>Design, develop and maintain scalable, high-quality software solutions.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with Product and Design teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.</li>
<li>Participate in architectural decisions and help shape the future of the Medify platform.</li>
<li>Conduct thoughtful code reviews and promote engineering best practices.</li>
<li>Troubleshoot and resolve software issues while maintaining high standards of reliability and performance.</li>
<li>Develop automated tests and contribute to a robust testing culture.</li>
<li>Participate in agile planning, backlog refinement and sprint delivery.</li>
<li>Stay up to date with emerging technologies and identify opportunities to improve our engineering practices.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>About You</p>
<p>You’ll be a technically strong engineering leader who enjoys developing people just as much as building great software. You’re comfortable balancing strategic leadership with hands-on development and thrive in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.</p>
<p>You’ll ideally have:</p>
<ul>
<li>2+ years’ experience leading or managing software engineering teams.</li>
<li>5+ years’ experience in software development.</li>
<li>Strong experience with modern software engineering practices and frameworks.</li>
<li>Experience with Ruby on Rails and React (highly desirable).</li>
<li>A proven track record of building scalable, maintainable software.</li>
<li>Experience working in Agile development environments.</li>
<li>Experience collaborating with cross-functional Product and Design teams.</li>
<li>Experience recruiting, mentoring and developing engineers.</li>
<li>Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.</li>
<li>Excellent problem-solving ability with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Qualifications</p>
<ul>
<li>Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline is desirable, but not essential.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>Technical Skills</p>
<ul>
<li>Strong knowledge of modern programming languages and software frameworks.</li>
<li>Excellent understanding of software architecture, design principles, data structures and algorithms.</li>
<li>Experience working with relational databases, APIs and networking.</li>
<li>Knowledge of automated testing frameworks and software quality practices.</li>
<li>Familiarity with DevOps tools and deployment pipelines.</li>
<li>Ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies.</li>
<li>Excellent collaboration and communication skills.<br><br></li>
</ul>
<p>✅ What We Offer</p>
<ul>
<li>Fully remote working with flexibility and autonomy.</li>
<li>The opportunity to shape the future of Medify’s technology platform.</li>
<li>A supportive, collaborative engineering culture that values continuous learning.</li>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, USA
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions.</strong></p></div><h3><strong>Why you’ll love this role:</strong></h3>
<p>StockX is the world’s leading marketplace for current culture, built at the intersection of commerce, community, and credibility. Apparel is foundational to StockX — not just as a category, but as an expression of identity, culture, and global trends.</p>
<p>We are expanding how apparel culture shows up on StockX through creator-driven, community-oriented commerce experiences that blend storytelling, expertise, and transaction. To do this well, we need category leaders who don’t just understand the apparel market — they live inside it.</p>
<p>The Apparel Category Manager is the single-threaded owner of apparel category growth within a new, high-priority commerce initiative. This person is the in-house expert on Fashion &amp; Apparel culture, people, economics, and moments — and is responsible for translating that expertise into supply growth, engagement, and GMV.</p>
<p>You will act as:</p>
<ul>
<li>The internal authority on the first-hand and second-hand apparel ecosystem</li>
<li>The external face of StockX to apparel sellers, creators, designers, and community leaders</li>
<li>The architect of the apparel go-to-market playbook for this new initiative</li>
</ul>
<p>This role blends deep cultural fluency, strategic ownership, and hands-on execution. Early on, you will own everything related to apparel within this initiative. As the category scales, you will grow into a leader overseeing a broader apparel portfolio and team.</p>
<h3><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h3>
<h4><strong>Own the Apparel Category End-to-End</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Define and execute the growth strategy for apparel within the platform</li>
<li>Own category-level performance across supply, engagement, and revenue</li>
<li>Establish quarterly goals, leading indicators, and operating rhythms</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Be the Market &amp; Culture Expert</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Maintain deep, current knowledge of apparel culture, including:</li>
<ul>
<li>Key sellers, creators, designers, brands, and retailers</li>
<li>Sub-segments (streetwear, luxury, contemporary, vintage, performance, regional styles, etc.)</li>
<li>Seasonal drops, brand dynamics, collaborations, and cultural moments</li>
<li>Pricing dynamics, liquidity, and resale economics</li>
</ul>
<li>Serve as the internal voice of the apparel community, informing product, marketing, and platform decisions</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Supply &amp; Creator Acquisition</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Build and own a pipeline of high-impact apparel sellers, shops, designers, influencers, brands, and creators</li>
<li>Personally recruit and onboard flagship sellers who set the tone for the platform</li>
<li>Develop seller strategies that balance credibility, storytelling, and commerce</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Commerce Strategy &amp; Category Moments</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Identify and orchestrate Fashion &amp; Apparel-specific moments, campaigns, and formats that drive engagement and conversion</li>
<li>Partner with Category Marketing to design culturally authentic activations</li>
<li>Experiment with new approaches and iterate quickly based on performance and feedback</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Work closely with Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller acquisition and support</li>
<li>Collaborate with Product and Engineering to shape features and tools that matter to category sellers and buyers</li>
<li>Provide clear, actionable insights from the market to influence roadmap prioritization</li>
</ul>
<h4><strong>Build the Playbook</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Document learnings, frameworks, and best practices that can be reused across future categories</li>
<li>Help define what “great” looks like for category ownership at StockX</li>
<li>Support hiring and onboarding as the apparel category team grows</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>About you:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Deeply embedded in second-hand fashion &amp; apparel culture — you know the people, platforms, trends, and economics, and you’re already plugged into the ecosystem</li>
<li>5+ years of experience in category management, partnerships, marketplace growth, brand, or operator roles in apparel, streetwear, fashion, or adjacent ecosystems</li>
<li>Comfortable owning outcomes, not just strategy — you execute, iterate, and adapt</li>
<li>Strong relationship builder with credibility among sellers, creators, designers, and community members</li>
<li>Data-literate and commercially minded — you understand pricing, margins, liquidity, and incentives</li>
<li>Entrepreneurial, scrappy, and energized by building something from the ground up</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Nice to Have:</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Existing network of apparel resellers, brand operators, designers, boutiques, or creators</li>
<li>Experience buying and selling apparel or operating within resale or fashion marketplaces</li>
<li>Familiarity with content-driven commerce, creator platforms, or enthusiast communities</li>
<li>Experience working cross-functionally with product and engineering teams</li>
<li>Experience running your own business or startup</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Why This Role Matters:</strong></h3>
<p>Apparel will define the early perception and success of this new commerce initiative at StockX. This role sets:</p>
<ul>
<li>The cultural bar for the platform</li>
<li>The go-to-market blueprint for future categories</li>
<li>The credibility of StockX with the apparel community</li>
</ul>
<p>You will have outsized influence on how StockX expands its leadership from marketplace into deeper cultural engagement.</p>
<div><em>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation.</em></div>
<div><em>&nbsp;</em></div>
<div><em>Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary.&nbsp;</em></div><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="job-preview__description ">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="job-preview__description "><strong>About StockX</strong></div>
<div class="job-preview__description "><strong><br></strong>StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com.</div>

      <title>Upgrade: AI Experience Engineer (Conversational AI)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Canada (Remote)
</p>

<p><span><strong>About the Role:</strong><br><br>An AI Experience Engineer owns the full lifecycle of the journeys our customers have with Upgrade's AI agent on chat, voice and email: creation, optimization, edge case handling and containment growth. They build journeys in Sierra's no-code tooling, partner with Upgrade's product groups to bring their servicing flows to the agent, and are accountable for whether the agent resolves the customer's issue safely, accurately and without a human.</span></p>
<p><span>We are hiring an AI Experience Engineer to own Upgrade's customer-facing AI agent. You will sit between engineering, product and customer operations. You will turn servicing workflows, such as making a payment, checking loan details, updating an address or enabling autopay, into production journeys and keep improving them after launch. </span><span>You will build and own the journeys end to end, from first draft to steady state. The work is part builder, part analyst: design the flow, handle the edge cases, read the transcripts, and keep raising containment. Containment, CSAT, transfer quality and hallucination rate are your metrics.</span></p>
<p><span>Within your first year, you will own a portfolio of journeys across products (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, HELOC, Deposits) and help set the standards for how Upgrade builds, tests and ships AI experiences.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Our Core Technologies</strong></span></p>
<p><span>Sierra Agent Studio (no-code journeys), Sierra simulations and conversation analytics, GraphQL and REST APIs (as journey tools), Genesys (contact center handoff), SumoLogic, Grafana, SQL, Javascript/Typescript, Claude and other LLM tools.</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What You'll Do</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Journey creation:</strong> Design and build Sierra journeys in Agent Studio for chat, voice and email, from discovery with operations through production rollout</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Optimization:</strong> Review transcripts, recordings and analytics every week, find where conversations fail or transfer, and ship fixes to journey logic, instructions and knowledge</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Edge case handling: </strong>Map the unhappy paths (failed payments, mismatched identity, delinquent accounts, unsupported requests) and make sure each ends in a correct answer or a clean handoff</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Containment:</strong> Own containment and CSAT targets per journey, run staged rollouts (1% → 100%), and prioritize the work that moves those numbers most</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Product partnership:</strong> Work with product groups (Personal Loans, Card, BNPL, Deposits) to scope new journeys, keep journeys current as products change, and define the APIs the agent needs</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Safety and compliance:</strong> Apply tiered authentication and step-up verification, verbatim compliance language and guardrails against hallucination and off-policy answers</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Handoffs:</strong> Design transfers to human agents in Genesys with accurate summaries and auth context</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Testing:</strong> Build simulation and regression suites so every journey change ships with evidence it did not break existing behavior</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Monitoring: </strong>Watch latency, errors and drop-offs in SumoLogic and Grafana, and own the alerts</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Voice tuning:</strong> Latency, filler phrases, interruptions, personality and tone</span></p>
<p><span>• <strong>Sierra relationship: </strong>Be the technical owner on our side, escalate platform issues and shape roadmap asks</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What We Look For:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• 3–5 years of Frontend Software Engineering experience, or equivalent experience in Solutions Engineering, Conversational AI or Technical Product roles</span></p>
<p><span>• Working knowledge of how LLM agents behave: instructions, tool calls, knowledge retrieval, and where each one fails</span></p>
<p><span>• Experience building evaluations for non-deterministic systems: test sets, simulations, LLM-as-judge, regression gates</span></p>
<p><span>• Enough technical depth to read API specs, work with backend engineers on REST and GraphQL integrations, and reason about authorization and permission scopes</span></p>
<p><span>• Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to build and maintain coded journeys and integrate APIs within conversational AI platforms.</span></p>
<p><span>• Product and customer mindset: you understand ops procedures, you read transcripts, care about tone, and measure success by whether the customer's problem got solved</span></p>
<p><span>• Ownership in production: rollouts, monitoring, log analysis and incident response</span></p>
<p><span>• Clear writing and the ability to work with non-engineers in operations, compliance and legal</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>Nice To Have:</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• Hands-on experience with Sierra Agent Studio, or a comparable no-code agent platform (Decagon, Ada, Kore.ai, Google CCAI, Amazon Lex/Connect)</span></p>
<p><span>• Voice AI experience: speech-to-text, text-to-speech, latency tuning, barge-in handling</span></p>
<p><span>• Contact center systems such as Genesys, and agent handoff design</span></p>
<p><span>• Background in fintech or another regulated industry (UDAAP, FDCPA, TCPA, PCI, SOC 2)</span></p>
<p><span>• Conversation design or UX writing experience</span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span><strong>What We Offer You:&nbsp;</strong></span></p>
<p><span>• Competitive salary ($140K-$180K CAN) and stock option plan</span></p>
<p><span>• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>• Flexible PTO</span></p>
<p><span>• Opportunities for professional growth and development<br>• Paid parental leave</span></p>
<p><span>• Health &amp; wellness initiatives</span></p>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - India
</p>

<h2><strong>About the Team</strong></h2>
<p>The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering <em>outcomes</em>, not just a platform.</p>
<p>You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."</p>
<h2><strong>Role Description</strong></h2>
<p>As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.</p>
<p>You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.</p>
<p>This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.</p>
<h2><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>C-Suite Scoping &amp; Value Definition:</strong> Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.</li>
<li><strong>End-to-End Product Ownership:</strong> Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Solution Leadership</strong><strong> &amp; Delivery:</strong> Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.</li>
<li><strong>Solution Launch &amp; Landing:</strong> Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.</li>
<li><strong>Strategic Handoff &amp; Growth:</strong> Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>What we look for</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Executive Presence &amp; Communication:</strong> You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Product Judgment &amp; Delivery:</strong> You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.</li>
<li><strong>Technical Fluency &amp; Architecture Judgment:</strong> You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on Technical Ability:</strong> You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.</li>
<li><strong>Relevant Experience:</strong> Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p>
<p><span>Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p>
<p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards.       <title>Vercel: Software Engineer - Data Platform</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote - United States
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h2>About Vercel:</h2>
<p><span>Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.</span></p>
<p><span>Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.</span></p></div><h2>About the Role</h2>
<p>We're looking for a Staff level Engineer to lead the design and development of a next-generation Data Platform at Vercel. This is a unique opportunity to architect a foundational system that will power data across our products and business, supporting everything from real-time analytics to AI/ML initiatives.</p>
<p>Reporting directly to the Senior Director of Data Engineering, you'll define the technical vision for our data ecosystem, work across the organization to align engineering strategy with product goals, and build scalable, reliable systems using modern technologies like Kafka, ClickHouse, Tinybird, and Snowflake.</p>
<p>You'll lead from the front, writing production-grade code, setting high standards for design and data governance, and mentoring a team of engineers as the organization grows. If you're excited by the challenge of building scalable data systems that drive product innovation, we'd love to hear from you.</p>
<h2>What You Will Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>Design and implement a next-generation data platform that supports diverse requirements, including batch and real-time integrations, advanced analytics, and multiple data types, leveraging Kafka, Kafka-based tooling, and additional streaming technologies to power real-time data movement and processing.</li>
<li>Work with engineering, product, and senior leadership teams across Vercel to architect solutions that address business needs, aligning technical strategies with product goals and ensuring seamless data availability and usability.</li>
<li>Define and maintain guidelines for data ingestion, creation, enrichment, and storage, while overseeing data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing (ClickHouse, Tinybird, Snowflake) to achieve low-latency analytics and scalable storage.</li>
<li>Develop end-to-end solutions across the tech stack, setting the example for engineering excellence, and provide mentorship and direction that fosters continuous improvement and innovation in the team.</li>
<li>Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure adherence to data protection standards, and champion high availability and fault tolerance through comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices.</li>
<li>Drive architectural decisions and roadmap planning that ensure efficiency, scalability, and high performance, and evaluate build-vs-buy trade-offs, integrating vendor solutions where appropriate.</li>
<li>Collaborate with data scientists and machine learning teams to evolve infrastructure that supports advanced analytics and AI initiatives, serving as a key contributor to strategy, tooling, and platform enhancements for ML-related workloads.</li>
<li>Act as a key decision-maker for discovering, vetting, and selecting data architectures and technologies critical to Vercel's success, and establish multi-phase strategic roadmaps that align with overall business objectives and drive data platform maturity.</li>
</ul>
<h2>About You</h2>
<ul>
<li>8+ years of experience in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, with at least 5 years at the Principal Engineer level.</li>
<li>Proven track record designing and operating large-scale data infrastructures at high scale in a complex, fast-paced environment, with experience across Kafka and its ecosystem (e.g., Kafka Streams, Confluent Platform), ClickHouse, Tinybird, Snowflake, and broader big data frameworks.</li>
<li>Proficiency in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and associated big data services.</li>
<li>Strong background in data governance and security, and adept at ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and protecting sensitive information.</li>
<li>Outstanding communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders across varying organizational levels.</li>
<li>A leadership mindset, with demonstrated ability to mentor teams, drive consensus, and advocate for best practices across the organization.</li>
<li>A Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.</li>
<li>Industry recognition or notable contributions in data engineering (e.g., published works, open-source contributions) is a plus.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Compensation &amp; Benefits:</h2>
<ul>
<li>Competitive compensation package, including equity.</li>
<li>Inclusive Healthcare Package.</li>
<li>Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.</li>
<li>Flexible Time Off.</li>
<li>We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.</li>
</ul>
<p>The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $232,000 - $348,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.</p>

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Vercel encourages everyone to apply for our available positions, even if they don't necessarily check every box on the job description.</li>
</ul></div>

      <title>Maven Clinic: Client Success Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com</p>
<p><strong>An award-winning culture working towards an important mission –&nbsp; Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026)</li>
<li>Fortune Change the World (2024)</li>
<li>CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024)</li>
<li>Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023)</li>
<li>Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024)</li>
</ul></div><p>Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our employer accounts.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for employer accounts introduced through Maven’s channel partnerships - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness.&nbsp; You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role,&nbsp; it’s a commercial position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen. This person will be on the front lines as a trusted advisor to our clients and a key partner to our channel partnership teams.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>As Client Success Manager at Maven, you will:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Support the success and satisfaction of your portfolio of employer clients, helping ensure strong client retention and engagement&nbsp;</li>
<li>Collaborate with channel/payer partner client executives to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio</li>
<li>Assist in building and maintaining account plans, tracking renewal milestones, and identifying opportunities for growth.</li>
<li>Monitor client health and engagement on an ongoing basis, flagging potential risks early and collaborating with your manager and team to develop mitigation plans.</li>
<li>Identify potential opportunities for client expansion and collaborate with Sales to build business cases and handoffs.</li>
<li>Partner with Sales and Renewals teams to ensure smooth account transitions and handoffs, contributing to clear narratives and data-supported recommendations.</li>
<li>Support client enrollment and engagement initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes, such as employee utilization, satisfaction, or program adoption.</li>
<li>Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and other client-facing presentations, sharing data insights and supporting renewal or expansion discussions.</li>
<li>Consult clients on program optimization using Maven’s expertise, benchmark data, and program resources, ensuring measurable business impact.</li>
<li>Maintain strong client relationships, fostering satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy, and supporting case studies or success stories where appropriate.</li>
<li>Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, analytics, marketing) to support client projects, timelines, and deliverables.</li>
<li>Manage client inquiries, issues, and escalations, coordinating with partner teams as needed to resolve challenges.</li>
<li>Share client insights internally to help improve products, processes, and marketing initiatives.</li>
<li>Recommend improvements to client workflows or processes, supporting scalable solutions to enhance outcomes.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What we’re looking for you to bring:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services within digital health, healthcare, benefits, or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and contribute to commercial outcomes.</li>
<li>Experience working with enterprise employer clients through channel/payer partners (5,000+ employees) preferred.</li>
<li>Proven ability to support and execute marketing or engagement strategies that drive measurable client outcomes.</li>
<li>Passion for healthcare and supporting organizational change.</li>
<li>Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless experience for clients, providing insights that inform product, process, or market improvements.</li>
<li>History of contributing to client retention, renewal management, and account growth opportunities.</li>
<li>Ability to build and maintain relationships with multiple stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance), navigating client environments effectively.</li>
<li>Experience partnering with Sales or Renewals teams to support commercial opportunities and account growth.</li>
<li>Strong interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders.</li>
<li>Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.</li>
<li>Analytical skills and strategic thinking – able to translate data and client performance into actionable insights in collaboration with clients.</li>
<li>Experience supporting the full lifecycle of customer success post-sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management).</li>
<li>Comfort operating in a growing and evolving environment, adaptable to changing processes and ambiguity.</li>
<li>Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 20%) for client meetings and participate in our NYC office when needed.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Helpful experiences and skills (not required, can be learned on the job):</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Experience at a digital health company in health, wellness, or family health space.</li>
<li>Experience with managing high volume of clients is preferred</li>
<li>Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients.</li>
<li>Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker, and Microsoft Office suite.</li>
</ul>
<p>The base salary range for this role is $106,000 - 120,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset.</p>
<p><strong>New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities)</strong>&nbsp;Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and&nbsp; Seattle, WA. &nbsp;For those based in NewYork, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction.<br>Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are&nbsp;<strong>expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days</strong>.</p>
<p><strong>This role requires active work authorization in the US.</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams.</p>
<p><strong>Benefits That Work For You</strong></p>
<p>Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits:</p>
<ul>
<li>Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics.</li>
<li>Whole-self care through wellness partnerships</li>
<li>Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days&nbsp;</li>
<li>16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+)</li>
<li>Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens</li>
<li>401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. <span>If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: </span><a href="mailto:security@mavenclinic.com"><span>security@mavenclinic.com</span></a><span>. </span>For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at&nbsp;<a href="mailto:careers@mavenclinic.com">careers@mavenclinic.com</a>.&nbsp;</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-client-success-manager">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-client-success-manager</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Typeform: Full Stack Developer</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Germany (Remote) ; Ireland (Remote); Netherlands (Remote) ; Portugal (Remote) ; Spain (Remote) ; United Kingdom (Remote) 
</p>

<div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3>
<p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. We help over 150,000 businesses collect the data they need with forms, surveys, and quizzes that people enjoy. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p><span class="s1"><span>Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal, Spain or The Netherlands</span><strong><br><br>About the team</strong></span></p>
<p class="p2">Typeform is a leading provider of interactive forms, surveys, and data collection experiences. We help businesses create more engaging ways to collect, manage, and understand data.</p>
<p class="p2">This team sits at the center of how Typeform builds product experiences, creating the shared foundations, tooling, and infrastructure that support scalable and consistent development across the platform.</p>
<h2><span class="s1"><strong>About the role</strong></span></h2>
<p class="p2">We’re looking for a Mid level Full Stack Engineer with a stronger backend focus to help evolve the internal systems and infrastructure that support our product development ecosystem.</p>
<p class="p2">This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building scalable internal platforms and developer tooling, while still being comfortable contributing across the frontend when needed. You’ll work on APIs, automation, release pipelines, and engineering infrastructure that improve how teams build and ship product experiences across Typeform.</p>
<p class="p2">You’ll partner closely with engineers and designers to improve tooling, workflows, and developer experience across the company.</p>
<h2><span class="s1"><strong>Things you will do</strong></span></h2>
<ul>
<li>Build and maintain backend services, APIs, and internal tooling used across product development teams</li>
<li>Improve infrastructure powering component distribution, asset management, documentation, and release workflows</li>
<li>Support and evolve the engineering monorepo, helping improve scalability, maintainability, and developer experience</li>
<li>Collaborate with frontend engineers and designers to ensure shared patterns and tooling are implemented consistently across products</li>
<li>Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, automation, testing, and deployment processes using tools like GitHub Actions</li>
<li>Help improve the reliability and performance of internal systems, including observability and monitoring workflows</li>
<li>Support engineers across product teams with adoption and integration of shared tooling and services</li>
<li>Contribute to documentation and developer tooling to improve discoverability and onboarding</li>
<li>Work on ongoing platform improvements, including:
<ul>
<li>Migration of legacy code and tooling</li>
<li>Documentation platform enhancements</li>
<li>Automation improvements</li>
<li>Sandbox and developer tooling improvements</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>Participate in architecture discussions and contribute practical, scalable engineering solutions</li>
</ul>
<h2><span class="s1"><strong>What you already bring to the table</strong></span></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience working with JavaScript or TypeScript in production environments</li>
<li>Good understanding of backend development principles and experience building APIs or internal services</li>
<li>Familiarity with Node.js and modern web frameworks such as React or Next.js</li>
<li>Experience working with relational databases and understanding of database design fundamentals</li>
<li>Understanding of testing practices and software quality principles</li>
<li>Familiarity with CI/CD workflows and developer tooling</li>
<li>Experience working with Git and collaborative engineering workflows</li>
<li>Strong communication skills and the ability to work cross functionally with designers and engineers</li>
<li>Interest in developer experience, platform engineering, or internal tooling</li>
</ul>
<h2><span class="s1"><strong>Extra awesome</strong></span></h2>
<ul>
<li>Experience working in a product led SaaS company</li>
<li>Exposure to frontend infrastructure or shared platform tooling</li>
<li>Familiarity with observability and monitoring tooling</li>
<li>Experience contributing to monorepos or internal platform tooling</li>
<li>Degree in Computer Science or a related technical field</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>*Typeform drives hundreds of millions of interactions each year, enabling conversational, human-centered experiences across the globe. We <strong>move as one team</strong>, empowering our collective efforts by valuing each individual’s unique perspective. This fosters <strong>strong bonds</strong> grounded in respect, transparency, and trust. We <strong>champion our diverse customer base</strong> by anticipating their needs and addressing their challenges with priority. Committed to excellence, we<strong> hold high expectations </strong>for ourselves and each other, continuously striving to deliver exceptional results.</p>
<p>We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and stand firmly against discrimination and harassment of any kind—whether based on race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. Everyone is welcome here.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-full-stack-developer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/typeform-full-stack-developer</a></p>
</description>

      <title>Jumio: Machine Learning Engineer - IV (Computer Vision)</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> India (remote)
</p>

<h2><strong>Machine Learning Engineer IV – (Computer Vision)</strong></h2>
<p>We’re looking for a Staff/Senior Machine Learning Engineer with deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics to lead the design and scaling of face recognition systems in production. You’ll build and train models, and own ML systems end-to-end on AWS. The final job level for this role will be determined following the interview process.</p>
<h3><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Lead the design and development of computer vision systems for biometrics (face attributes, detection, quality, and recognition)</li>
<li>Rigorous fairness analysis and benchmarking of biometric models across various datasets and operating conditions.</li>
<li>Architect, train, and optimize models using PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or JAX</li>
<li>Own and evolve end-to-end ML pipelines, from data ingestion to deployment. Design automated pipelines (Airflow) for data ingestion and cleaning. You will be responsible for curating balanced training sets and generating synthetic data to address both quality and diversity gaps.</li>
<li>Production Engineering: Own the path to production. Optimize models for low-latency inference (quantization, distillation, TensorRT/ONNX) and manage deployment on AWS.</li>
<li>Mentor ML engineers, conduct code/design reviews, and drive technical best practices across the Computer Vision team.</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Strong industry experience in Machine Learning, dedicated to Biometrics or Face Analysis.</li>
<li>Deep expertise in computer vision and biometrics, especially face recognition.</li>
<li>Fairness &amp; Ethics: You understand the sources of algorithmic bias in Computer Vision and have practical experience measuring and mitigating disparate impact.</li>
<li>Strong Engineering: Expert proficiency in Python (both machine learning and vision libraries such as Pillow, OpenCV, PyTorch, etc). You write clean, modular, production-ready code.</li>
<li>Systems Architecture: Experience designing end-to-end ML pipelines (Data to Train to Deploy) and working with workflow orchestrators like Airflow.</li>
<li>Cloud Native: Hands-on experience scaling training jobs on multi-GPU clusters and deploying services on AWS (SageMaker, EC2, EKS).</li>
</ul>
<h3><strong>Nice to Have</strong></h3>
<ul>
<li>Research Publications: Papers in CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or FG related to face recognition, image quality assessment, or fairness.</li>
<li>Large Scale Search: Experience with vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Faiss) and approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search algorithms.</li>
<li>Familiarity with privacy, security, and compliance in biometric systems.</li>
<li>Mobile/Edge Experience: Experience porting models to edge or mobile devices utilizing frameworks such as CoreML, LiteRT, and/or TFLite.</li>
<li>Synthetic Data: Experience using GANs or diffusion models to generate synthetic faces for training.</li>
<li>Strong communication skills.</li>
</ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Jumio Values:</strong></p>
<p><span>IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation </span></p>
<p><strong>Equal Opportunities</strong><span><strong>: </strong></span></p>
<p><span>Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.</span></p>
<p><strong>About Jumio:</strong></p>
<p>Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.</p>
<p><strong>Applicant Data Privacy </strong></p>
<p>We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s <a href="https://www.jumio.com/legal-information/privacy-notices/candidate-notice/">Applicant Privacy Notice.</a> If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to <a href="mailto:privacy@jumio.com">privacy@jumio.com</a>.</p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-machine-learning-engineer-iv-computer-vision">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-machine-learning-engineer-iv-computer-vision</a></p>
</description>

Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

As an Account Executive on our Commercial team, you will drive new business for Spotify Technology. You'll focus on companies with fewer than 1,000 employees, where sales cycles typically run from weeks to a few months and success depends on a repeatable, scalable sales motion. ","id":"cf13d272-92ac-407d-89bf-7f20d20f7961","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

• Identify and pursue new business opportunities with organizations of 1,000+ employees. This is a “Hunter” role with significant inbound and SDR support.

• Research and prospect into target accounts, building strategic account plans that map stakeholders, priorities, and opportunities for long-term growth.

• Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, proactively engaging multiple stakeholders, including CTOs, VPs of Engineering, Product leaders, platform teams, developer experience leaders, procurement, security, and legal.

• Build multi-threaded relationships across each account and develop multiple internal champions to secure new deals and support expansion over time.

• Achieve and exceed revenue targets while maintaining accurate pipeline and forecast data for long-cycle deals.

• Structure and negotiate agreements that support customer adoption, expansion, and long-term success.

• Articulate how Backstage Portal and Confidence solve developer experience challenges at scale, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

• Tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

• Build business cases and return-on-investment (ROI) narratives that resonate with executive buyers.

• Partner closely with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations, proofs of concept, and integration planning.

• Collaborate with Customer Success to support retention and identify expansion opportunities across business units, while sharing customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

• Travel up to 30% of the time to meet existing and prospective customers in your regional market, strengthen relationships, and support business growth.

    LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job.

    The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next.

    We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.

    We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

    This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.

    As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.

    We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

  • Guide the evolution and modernization of complex legacy systems into scalable, reliable architecture.
  • Partner closely with product and cross-functional leaders to align priorities and drive execution.
  • Improve system reliability and reduce operational friction in workflows that directly impact content availability.
  • Identify and apply opportunities for automation and AI to improve data quality and engineering productivity.
  • Build an inclusive engineering culture where teams continuously improve how they work and deliver.
  • Develop and execute a long-term roadmap that balances immediate priorities with strategic investments.

    We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.

    This position sits at the heart of Spotify’s Content Platform, responsible for the systems that define, structure, and govern content across the platform. Our mission is to provide a trusted, consistent source of truth so content can be reliably managed and reused across every Spotify experience. We build and operate the core systems and workflows that ensure content is accurate, complete, and available, from APIs and lifecycle orchestration through to content quality and integrity.

    As Spotify’s content ecosystem continues to grow in scale and complexity across new formats, use cases, and regulatory environments, this domain plays a critical role in helping us scale intentionally while maintaining the trust and quality our users and creators expect.

    We’re seeking a Director of Engineering to lead this domain, shaping its technical direction, developing teams, and evolving the systems that underpin Spotify’s global content platform.

    ","id":"8d54dd6d-d7e0-4298-b051-423bcec4089e","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"
  • Coordinate litigation, pre-litigation, regulatory, and other dispute matters across multiple practice areas, including copyright and patent litigation.
  • Work with outside counsel to develop case strategy, manage budgets, and drive efficient resolution of contentious disputes.
  • Partner with the business on litigation and legal risk issues and work with colleagues to fashion solutions that balance legal risk with company objectives.
  • Develop litigation case strategies, work closely with Spotify's communications team, and formulate plans to resolve disputes efficiently.
  • Plan strategically and coordinate internally with legal and non-legal personnel on issues of the moment.
  • Provide proactive advice to internal team members on dispute avoidance and resolution, including risk mitigation.
  • Identify and mitigate threats against the company, whether from partners, users, content owners, or others.
  • Handle requests for information from the company, including subpoenas and requests from law enforcement.
  • Build scalable processes to address a growing number of claims across copyright, patent, and other areas.
  • Train teams and draft workflows and policies to help establish effective internal risk mitigation procedures.
  • Stay current on developments in patent and copyright law, particularly as they affect the technology and media industries.

    At Spotify, our Subscriptions Mission focuses on creating experiences that help listeners discover the value of Spotify, become subscribers, and stay with us for the long term. By combining technology, experimentation, and a deep understanding of our users, we help connect artists and fans while building a sustainable subscription business.

    Within the Subscriptions Mission, the Subs Foundational Models Product Area is part of the Subs User Understanding Studio. We build scalable machine learning solutions that personalize the subscriber journey, from conversion through to long-term retention. Working closely with teams across the mission, we develop ML solutions that improve key business metrics, including subscriber growth, monthly active users, and Premium retention.

    We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Radius squad. You'll take ownership of impactful ML initiatives, develop and improve production models, and contribute to the foundational ML capabilities that power personalization and optimization across Subscriptions.

    Your work could include reducing friction for Free users while balancing retention and conversion, improving payment experiences to reduce Premium churn, or developing reusable models such as subscriber embeddings that support multiple products and use cases.

Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles: Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later. Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.     Conduct groundbreaking research in generative audio using diffusion or flow matching models, with a focus on one or more of the following areas:

This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth.

    ","id":"66184cac-4d6c-46f6-868c-bac0c184fd22","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Own sales operations for Spotify Technology, including CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, territory and account assignment, and deal desk processes.

    • Design and roll out a segmented sales model that evolves our go-to-market approach as the business matures.

    • Build infrastructure and systems to support a scalable Commercial sales motion (companies with fewer than 1,000 employees), focused on faster deal cycles, efficient lead routing, and repeatable processes.

    • Build infrastructure and systems to support a strategic Enterprise sales motion (companies with 1,000+ employees), enabling prospecting, account planning, and multi-product engagements.

    • Partner with the Director of Sales as a strategic advisor on quota setting, capacity planning, compensation, territory design, and headcount modeling.

    • Support revenue across the full customer lifecycle, including new business, expansion, and retention.

    • Build reporting and dashboards to track pipeline coverage, conversion rates, time to close, forecast accuracy, and net revenue retention by segment.

    • Strengthen forecasting discipline and maintain a healthy, predictable pipeline through effective reporting and sales processes.

    • Identify friction across the sales process, including handoffs between Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and drive improvements with cross-functional partners.

    • Partner with Marketing on pipeline generation reporting, lead management, and process improvements.

    • Establish and continuously improve operating rhythms, including forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs), as the business scales.

    • Evaluate and manage the go-to-market (GTM) technology stack to support efficient and scalable sales operations.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have 6+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or go-to-market strategy, with a track record of meaningful impact at a senior level.

    • You have experience scaling sales operations through a startup or high-growth phase and understand when to introduce new processes and structure.

    • You can build systems and processes from the ground up without adding unnecessary complexity.

    • You are proficient in using AI and can lead initiatives that improve sales effectiveness through AI-enabled tools and processes.

    • You have experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within developer platforms, DevOps tools, or cloud services.

    • You understand the differences between product-led growth (PLG), Commercial, and Enterprise sales motions and have experience designing segmented sales models.

    • You understand complex technical sales involving Sales Engineering and recognize the importance of customer retention and post-sale success in revenue strategy.

    • You have hands-on experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM, including building reports, workflows, and resolving data issues.

    • You use data to guide forecasting, capacity modeling, and funnel analysis, combining analytical skills with sound business judgment.

    • You can influence senior sales leaders, build alignment across teams, and drive decisions without formal authority.

    • You are comfortable working in evolving environments, adapting as priorities change, and helping shape how an innovative business grows.

    Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.

    As Sales Manager for our Enterprise team, you will lead the Account Executives who drive new business for Spotify Technology. Reporting to the Director of Sales, you'll set the strategy for how we win with organizations of 1,000+ employees, where buying committees span engineering, finance, procurement, security, and legal, and fewer, larger deals can take many months to close.

    This is both a strategic and hands-on role: you'll shape our enterprise sales approach while staying close to the deals, coaching your team through complex opportunities and helping them close.     ","id":"80774cf2-a4f5-47b0-a585-2c122500cfd0","lists":[{"text":"What You'll Do","content":"

    • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives, helping each seller grow their skills and consistently achieve or exceed their targets.

    • Own quarterly and annual team revenue targets for new business with organizations of 1,000+ employees, in partnership with the Director of Sales.

    • Translate Spotify Technology's overall sales strategy into a clear enterprise plan, including target accounts, territory priorities, and account planning standards.

    • Build a team that converts inbound demand while proactively hunting new opportunities in target accounts.

    • Stay hands-on in key deals, joining customer meetings, supporting negotiations, and helping navigate complex buying committees.

    • Coach the team on strategic account planning, multi-threading, champion building, and developing executive-level business cases.

    • Run a disciplined operating rhythm through regular pipeline reviews, deal reviews, and one-on-ones, while maintaining accurate forecasts and a healthy, predictable pipeline for long-cycle deals.

    • Partner with Revenue Operations on territory design, reporting, and process improvements for the Enterprise segment.

    • Collaborate with Sales Engineering on technical evaluations and proofs of concept, with Customer Success on retention and expansion, and with Marketing on account-based programs and pipeline generation.

    • Help sellers articulate how Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp solve developer experience challenges, including how AI is reshaping software development in large organizations.

    • Help sellers tell a compelling story about Spotify's internal approach to solving engineering challenges and how our products are proven internally at scale.

    • Share customer feedback with Product and internal teams to help shape the roadmap.

    • Contribute to hiring, onboarding, and developing sales playbooks as the Enterprise team grows.

    "},{"text":"Who You Are","content":"

    • You have 8+ years of experience in B2B SaaS sales, including closing large, complex enterprise deals, and 3+ years of experience managing sales teams.

    • You have a proven track record of building and developing high-performing teams that consistently achieve or exceed targets in enterprise environments.

    • You are both strategic and hands-on, comfortable setting direction while staying involved in the details of individual deals.

    • You bring strong judgment when working with incomplete information and can coach your team to prioritize high-potential opportunities while confidently moving away from poorly qualified deals.

    • You have experience selling to engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams, or developer experience buyers, and understand how they evaluate and make purchasing decisions.

    • You are familiar with software development, Product Management, DevOps tools, or developer ecosystems.

    • You understand long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, including procurement processes, security reviews, and multi-year agreements.

    • You have experience partnering closely with Sales Engineering and understand the importance of technical depth in complex enterprise sales.

    • You use data and metrics to guide forecasting, coaching, and decision-making, while building structure and processes without adding unnecessary complexity.

    • You bring strong communication, coaching, negotiation, and presentation skills.

    • You are excited to help build a scalable enterprise sales motion with AI and enjoy working with innovative products in an evolving technology landscape.

    "},{"text":"Where You'll Be","content":"
